_comment: Card timings (seconds) for the 30-year reunion montage. Measured frame by frame on the iMovie export 30_Year_Video_montage.mov (254.67 s, 1080p30). 'under_in' and 'under_out' are frames just outside the old card, held still beneath the new card while it fades, so the old card never shows through.
_ending: End card after the montage (needs --song). The montage audio is 'Mustafa Mustafa' (Kadhal Desam) from 0 s, cut at 254.667 s; the song continues under the end card and fades out on the pause at 268.0-268.25 s.
